author: China Insights
description:
In recent months, images of long queues at passport offices, falling property prices in major cities, and a surge in gig work have sparked widespread discussion about China’s economic trajectory. What do these developments really mean? In this episode, we take a closer look at the structural changes behind the headlines — from the housing market downturn and shifting labour patterns to broader macroeconomic indicators. By connecting data with real-life stories, we explore whether China is entering a new economic phase, and what that could mean for ordinary people.

#China #ChinaEconomy #Economics #GigEconomy #RealEstate #GlobalEconomy #analysis
title: Is China Entering a “Gig Economy Era”? What the Data — and People — Are Telling Us I China Insights

author: China Insights
description: In this episode, we witness a group arriving in large vehicles to perform a "blood test" on villagers, including left-behind children. The villagers express confusion and surprise about this medical procedure taking place in their rural area. This event is presented as a way to "give life" and potentially "save lives" by pre-registering organ donors, raising questions about the ethics and understanding surrounding such medical interventions.
title: Blood Tests or Something Darker in Rural Villages #china #investigation
